attacks.name: Uncontrollable Weapon
steps: |!wild| |!hit| |*Rampage|: After this attack is resolved, deal 1 |!damage| to each other character within |!range| 2 of this character.

|!wild| |!wild| |*Wild Abandon| : After this attack is resolved, this character may make an additional |*Uncontrollable Weapon| attack without paying the |!power| cost. superPowers.name: Charge

superPowers.name: Adamantium Skeleton
